To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
28-HBL is more effective than 24-EBL in ameliorating the antioxidant enzyme activities and growth in the form shoot length in B. juncea L. seedlings under field conditions.
24-EBL and HBL are more effective at germinating stage in scavengenging the free radical and in the growth of seedlings.
10−8M HBL is the most effective concentration in ameliorating the growth and antioxidant activities in 10 day seedlings of Brassicajuncea L.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of 24-EBL and its homologues on the growth and activities of antioxidant enzymes in the seedlings.
the role of 28-HBL and 24-EBL in the growth and antioxidant system in the seedlings.
the effects of 24-EBL and its homologue, 28-HDL, on the growth and antioxidative enzymes in the seedlings under field conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

24-EBL and homobrassino-lide (28-HBL), both have the ability to enhance the growth in the form shoot length and activities of antioxidant enzymes, but 28-HBL has a more pronounced effect on the activities of antioxidant enzymes.
both the active forms of BR viz. EBL and HBR were found to be equally effective in improving growth and enhancing the activity of antioxidant enzymes in the seedlings.

28-HBL is a more potent form as compared to 28-EB as it ameliorates the activities of PPO, APOX, CAT and SOD in the seedling stage of B. juncea L., which are the key enzymes in the process of plant growth and development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
both 24-EBL and HBL have the potential to increase the seedling vigor and to ameliorate the antioxidant system in the seedlings.
the application of exogenous EBL and HBS at the time of seed sowing helps in ameliorating the seed germination and growth of seedlings of B. juncea.
both the BRs have the capacity to ameliorate the growth of the plants by scavenging the reactive oxygen species (ROS) produced during germination and initial growth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
24-EBL and homobrassinsolide can be used to enhance growth and to ameliorate the activities of antioxidant enzymes in the seedlings.
28-HBL is more effective than 24-EBL in ameliorating the growth of Brassica junceal L. (RSM 619) seedlings.
24-EBL and HBL have the potential to ameliorate oxidative stress in seedlings and thus, can be used as plant growth promoters.
